reference_provenance.usage: engineering reference for strict single-policy on-policy PPO and hierarchical gate/amount probability semantics only; no LRMB runtime dependency

environment.training_water_availability: W100 upper bound only; the learned policy minimizes actual use below this cap

policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.behavior_probability_contract: PPO likelihood ratios use the sampled gate and pre-tanh amount latent. Environment projection/canonicalization never replaces the sampled behavior action in the PPO log-probability.

reward.name: feasibility_first_scalar_surrogate
reward.terminal_violation_penalty: 0 if R >= eta else -(1 + eta - R)
reward.reason: With I_policy/495 in [0,1], every target-feasible episode has return in [-1,0] while every target-infeasible episode has return below -1. The surrogate therefore prioritizes per-year target feasibility before water saving without a tunable penalty coefficient.
reward.not_claimed_as: LCVaR optimization; PPO remains a scalar expected-return baseline and formal risk is evaluated separately using Risk Contract v1

training.seed_selection: forbidden; all five seeds remain independent replicates

validation.selection: one checkpoint per training seed using awm-learned-method-evaluation-v1

change_rule: Any change to PPO architecture, reward surrogate, optimizer hyperparameters, scheduler, seeds, normalization, checkpoint cadence or validation action mode after formal PPO training begins requires a new PPO protocol version.
